Module io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations
Package io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.info

Annotation Interface Contact

@Target({}) @Retention(RUNTIME) public @interface Contact
The annotation may be used in Info.contact() to define a contact for the OpenAPI spec.
